Title: Verify successful login with valid credentials redirects to Dashboard
Precondition: The registered user account with username 'Admin' and password 'admin123' exists and is active. The login page is reachable and no active session exists in the browser.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page loads displaying the OrangeHRM logo, the Username field, the Password field, the 'Login' button, and the 'Forgot your password?' link | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the field labelled 'Username' → Expected: The Username field shows 'Admin' with no validation error | 3. Enter 'admin123' into the field labelled 'Password' → Expected: The Password field shows masked characters with no validation error | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: The user is authenticated and redirected to the Dashboard page (URL contains '/dashboard/index') within 3 seconds; the Dashboard heading is displayed
Expected Result: The user is authenticated, a valid session is created, and the Dashboard page is displayed.

Title: Verify direct access to a protected Dashboard URL after logout redirects to login

Title: Verify SQL/script injection strings in the Username field are sanitized and rejected
Precondition: The login page is loaded. No active session exists. The system is expected to sanitize input and prevent SQL Injection and XSS.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page is displayed | 2. Enter the string ' OR '1'='1 into the Username field → Expected: The Username field accepts the raw text without executing or interpreting it | 3. Enter the string <script>alert(1)</script> into the Password field → Expected: The Password field masks the input and no script executes / no alert dialog appears | 4. Click the 'Login' button → Expected: Authentication is not bypassed; an 'Invalid credentials' error is displayed, no SQL error is exposed, no script alert fires, and the user remains on the login page
Expected Result: Injection payloads are sanitized and rejected as invalid credentials with no authentication bypass and no script execution.

Title: Verify credentials are transmitted over HTTPS and never appear in the URL
Precondition: The login page is loaded over HTTPS. Browser DevTools Network tab (or a proxy such as Burp) is available to inspect the login request.
Steps: 1. Open browser DevTools, select the Network tab, and navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The page loads over HTTPS and the connection is shown as secure | 2. Enter 'Admin' into the Username field and 'admin123' into the Password field, then click the 'Login' button → Expected: A login request is captured in the Network tab | 3. Inspect the captured login request method, URL, and payload → Expected: The request uses HTTPS and the POST method; the username and password are carried in the request body, not in the URL query string | 4. Inspect the final Dashboard URL and browser address bar → Expected: No credential values appear anywhere in the URL or query parameters
Expected Result: Credentials are transmitted over HTTPS in the request body and never exposed in the URL or query parameters.

Title: Verify account lockout or throttling engages after repeated failed login attempts
Precondition: The registered user 'Admin' exists. No active session exists. Brute-force protection (lockout or throttling) is expected per the security NFR.
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com/web/index.php/auth/login → Expected: The login page is displayed | 2. Submit the login form with username 'Admin' and password 'wrongPassword0' five consecutive times → Expected: Each attempt returns an 'Invalid credentials' error | 3. Attempt a sixth login submission with the same invalid credentials → Expected: The system engages protection: the account is temporarily locked, a CAPTCHA/throttling delay is enforced, or a lockout message is displayed, rather than continuing to accept unlimited attempts | 4. Attempt to log in with the correct password 'admin123' while lockout/throttling is active → Expected: Login is blocked or delayed per the protection policy until the lockout/throttle window expires, confirming brute-force protection is active
Expected Result: After repeated failed attempts the system enforces lockout or throttling rather than allowing unlimited login attempts.
